name: explain-simply
description: Re-explain the last answer, a plan, or any named document as short bullets a non-technical reader gets in one pass, keeping every number, name and file path.

interface.shortDescription: Say that again in short bullets, without losing a single number.
interface.longDescription: Takes the last answer, a plan, or any file you name and rewrites it as short bullets grouped under bold headings, at a reading level anyone can follow in one pass. Every number, date, file path and person's name survives, because a simple explanation that dropped the facts is not simpler, only vaguer. Ends with a numbered list of what you have to do, and only when there is something to do.
